items.rationale: The model keeps nothing between calls or sessions; only text the program saves and loads into the new context is available. Option d shows the idea that the model learns from chats, which it does not.
Call 1 = 2,100; call 2 = 2,100 + 500 = 2,600; call 3 = 2,600 + 500 = 3,100. Total 7,900. An answer of 3,100 counts only the last call; 5,200-ish answers forget the fixed part is re-sent.
The model can only use what is in its context, so a wrong answer with the right passage existing points first to retrieval: inspect exactly which passages were placed in the context.

items.answer: A context window only lasts one session and is empty in the next; the status must be saved outside the context and loaded back in.
accepted: the window is cleared when the session ends, so the status must be stored outside it
a bigger window does not persist between sessions; you need saved notes or a record
context is lost when the chat ends, so it needs external storage such as notes or a database
items.rationale: The window holds one session's content and resets afterwards. Size does not create persistence; saved notes or records, loaded back into context, do.
Compaction is summarizing a conversation near the window limit and reinitiating a fresh window with the summary.
